name: Pyro Volcanique
description: Phénix tacticien utilisant ses cendres pour bloquer les lignes ennemies et créer des murs de fumée infranchissables.

subject.archetype: Pyro Volcanique — Héritiers des cendres Rare spore

loadout.armor_outfit: Peaux noircies avec veines lumineuses orange. Armures de métal fondu et cendres compactées. Cheveux comme de la fumée. Cicatrices tribales.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's heal ability (self) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Dynamic action pose mid-ability execution — character actively demonstrating their specialty skill — Golden regenerative energy wrapping around wounds, restoring damaged flesh and armor

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Ember Orange
palette_names.role: primary_accent — glowing veins and fire effects

palette_names.name: Charcoal Black
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — scorched skin and armor base

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic rim lighting separating character from background with a focal glow on the primary ability effect

camera.angle: low dramatic angle emphasizing power and heroic stature

scenography.setting: Smoldering ruins of a destroyed settlement, half-melted structures glowing from residual heat, rivers of slow-moving lava carving through the devastated landscape
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Rising embers carried by thermal updrafts, heat distortion shimmer in the air, thick smoke plumes blocking the sky, volcanic ash falling like snow, plus self-repair — visible mending of injuries closing before the viewer's eyes visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Phénix tacticien utilisant ses cendres pour bloquer les lignes ennemies et créer des murs de fumée infranchissables.
card_metadata.faction_lore: Les Héritiers des Cendres sont les survivants de la Grande Purification — un cataclysme qui consuma leurs mondes entiers. Leur existence est une vengeance perpétuelle.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols deeply engraved on each corner of the border
card_metadata.composition_directive: Low angle heroic full-body shot emphasizing power, with ability visualization clearly shown in action
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
